items.question: Is the price on this page what I will pay?
items.answer: It is where your job starts. Your vehicle and your glass can move it, so the shop confirms your exact price before anything is booked.

items.question: Why do some rows have no number?
items.answer: The site only shows a price the shop has confirmed. Where a number is not posted yet, the shop gives you the exact price for your vehicle or your home.

items.question: What changes the price of car tint?
items.answer: Mostly how much glass you cover and the size and shape of your vehicle. Old film to remove can move it too. A windshield top strip or a sunroof is priced as its own line.

items.question: How much is windshield chip repair?
items.answer: Call Tuesday to Saturday, 9 to 5, with the number of chips and where they sit on the glass, and we will give you the price. We look at every chip before we repair it.
items.answer_when_published: The first chip is {chip_repair_first} and each additional chip is {chip_repair_additional}. We look at every chip before we repair it.
items.template_note: Use answer_when_published ONLY when both chip prices pass priceFor() in production mode (status confirmed AND publish true). Fill the tokens from each entry's display field. The FAQPage JSON-LD carries the same answer the page shows.

items.question: Do you charge for a quote?
items.answer: No. Estimates are free, including a free consultation with measurements for homes and offices.

items.question: Can I see the shade before I decide?
items.answer: Yes. Build your tint on this site to see each window on screen, then ask to see the film on your glass at the shop. Light, interior color and factory glass all change the real look.
